rule: BUILT only when proven to work and brick tested, both re-run when this file was made
north_star: Every person able to stop working and live by choice, with the energy they spend chosen, never a byproduct of chaos.

check-browser.name: Check, in your browser
check-browser.why: one sentence gives one claim: no fragment of a claim is shown again as a second claim failed

north.does: Saves the hours people spend double-checking AI answers by hand, on any device, right in the browser.
north.limit: Plain code finds and checks only math, units, rounding and primes: 18 of 74 claims (24.3%) in 20 real AI answers.
north.label: MEASURED

works.what: same as the Python checkers on 161 real claims, never the opposite
a real browser clicks Check; nothing leaves the page
one box above the fold on a laptop and a phone; Enter runs it and "1-4 is -3" comes back PROVEN with a receipt
every GUESS names the checker it is missing; nothing is left unexplained
one sentence gives one claim: no fragment of a claim is shown again as a second claim

bricks.what: planted mistakes fired at every proven claim; every one caught
five real bugs planted in the checkers; the brick test catches every one

own-ai.name: Check, with your own AI
own-ai.why: no real AI reply tested yet, since that needs a real key

north.does: Finds the claims plain code misses, so more of an answer gets checked.
north.limit: Needs a paid AI key, and no real reply has been tested yet.
north.label: GUESS

works.what: the key goes only to Anthropic, saved nowhere
the key goes only to OpenAI, saved nowhere

bricks.what: planted bad AI replies (a corrected number, an invented web address, junk); none gets a claim proven

atlas.name: The Human Autobiography (the Atlas as a book)

north.does: Shows in one look what is already proven, so nobody spends effort proving it again.
north.limit: 170 machine-checked facts so far; 0 of the 9 levels have none yet.
north.label: MEASURED

works.what: a real browser opens every old Atlas address and lands on the book at the right fact's page, with no old map words

bricks.what: every unproven claim is kept off the map; every Lean fact names a real theorem
five bad facts planted on the map (a guess, a false claim, made-up Lean and Mathlib theorems, an edited Mathlib statement); the brick test refuses every one, and must pass the real map first

lookup.name: Look it up in Wikipedia and Grokipedia
lookup.why: finds only near word-for-word sentences: 1 of 141 real encyclopedia claims on Wikipedia (MEASURED 2026-10-29)

works.what: known answers on saved pages: both sources, one source, Grokipedia down

bricks.what: planted wrong claims (a swapped name, a changed number, an added "not", a saying quoted as a myth) never CHECKED; sources that disagree are never CHECKED; the relay refuses every escape

names.name: Check the package name on PyPI or npm

north.does: Catches the package names AIs make up before anyone installs one.
north.limit: 12 of 1,921 real AI answers had an install command; 1 named a package that does not exist (pip install sqlite3).
north.label: MEASURED

works.what: real names on a saved registry: one name, two names, scoped npm names, versions, extras and flags read right

bricks.what: planted made-up names (a fake package, a one-letter typo, a fake npm name, one fake beside a real one) and a claim that says more than the install are never CHECKED; a registry that does not answer is never "not found"

trace.name: Trace any fact to the root, and the scoreboard

north.does: Shows what any fact rests on, step by step, so nobody re-checks what is already checked.
north.limit: The time it saves is a guess until it is timed with real people.
north.label: GUESS

works.what: known chains come out exactly so; every fact reaches a root
every scoreboard number matches a fresh recount
clicked like a visitor in a real browser: the Root Theorem, infinite primes and the turkey each show the expected steps and end at a ROOT

bricks.what: planted fakes (a nudged count, a hand-filled time, a number with no rule, a chain cut short, a bad label, a fact with no machine checker) are all rejected

builtin-ai.name: Chrome's built-in AI
builtin-ai.why: no proof that it works yet; not brick tested yet; not yet tested on a Chrome that has its built-in AI

north.does: Finds more claims with no key and no cost, on the device.
north.limit: Only in some versions of Chrome, and untested.
north.label: GUESS

cloud.name: Cloud
cloud.why: no proof that it works yet; not brick tested yet; coming soon

north.does: Fast checking for people who want no download and no key.
north.limit: Costs money to run, so it waits for real use and fair funding.
north.label: GUESS

north.does: Lets people join, so the work is shared and nobody carries it alone.
north.limit: Works: one real sign-up passed end to end on 2026-10-29. Its limit is how many people hear about it.
north.label: MEASURED

works.what: one real sign-up passed (2026-10-29: confirm email, click, welcome email, subscriber logged); the form is still that one

bricks.what: planted broken forms (wrong list, a GET, same tab, a renamed email box, switched off, a fetch, no next-step note) are all refused
